answer: Unique Whisper Binding**: Each agent generates a unique cryptographic whisper tied to a specific place or time (e.g., a GPS-locked event in the tundra). The whisper is unrepeatable and verifiable via a one-time proof. To clone, an attacker must fabricate a valid whisper for every new identity, requiring costly physical presence or sensor exploitation. Each sable-verified identity enforces this mechanism, raising the cost of replication significantly.
